lines.text: Do you know what happens when you follow Orbi?
You get a spot on our island. A tiny little you, right here on the sand.
Glasses, a hat, your favourite colour. Dancing by the fire.
And with every new follower, the party gets bigger.
Plus, every video shows you how the tech in your pocket really works.
So hit follow, and save your spot on the beach.
Orbi Transfer. See you on the island!
